CompanySwitcher.description: Allows users to switch between multiple companies they have access to using a dropdown selector.

withHeader.description: Controls whether to render the container header section. Set to false when embedding the container within a layout that already provides its own header to avoid duplicate navigation elements.

withWrapper.description: Controls whether to wrap the container in a styled wrapper element. Set to false when integrating with existing design systems or when the container is embedded within another styled component that provides its own layout structure.

className.description: Adds custom CSS classes to the container element. Use to override default styles, integrate with existing design systems, or apply conditional styling based on application state.

approvalRuleID.description: Specifies the unique identifier for the approval rule to display or manage. Required to fetch the correct rule data from the backend when viewing or editing existing rules.

routeApprovalRulesList.description: Function to generate the URL for navigating to the approval rules list. Use to implement custom routing logic or add query parameters.

routePurchaseOrderDetails.description: Function to generate the URL for navigating to the purchase order details. Use to implement custom routing logic or add query parameters.

onBack.description: Callback function triggered when user navigates back. Use to implement custom navigation logic or track user behavior.

onSuccess.description: Callback function triggered on successful completion. Use to implement custom success handling, navigation, or notifications.

onError.description: Callback function triggered when an error occurs. Use to implement custom error handling, logging, or user notifications.

purchaseOrderId.description: Specifies the unique identifier for the purchase order to display or manage. Required to fetch the correct purchase order data from the backend when viewing details or performing operations on a specific order.

requisitionListId.description: Specifies the unique identifier for the requisition list to display or manage. Required to fetch the correct list data from the backend when viewing details or performing operations on a specific list.

routeRequisitionList.description: Function to generate the URL for navigating to the requisition list. Use to implement custom routing logic or add query parameters.

routeRequisitionListView.description: Function to generate the URL for navigating to the requisition list view. Use to implement custom routing logic or add query parameters.

companyId.description: Specifies the unique identifier for the company to display or manage. Required to fetch company-specific data from the backend when viewing company details or performing company-level operations.

userId.description: Specifies the unique identifier for the user to display or manage. Required to fetch user-specific data from the backend when viewing user details or performing user-level operations.

ariaLabel.description: Sets a custom aria-label for the company picker dropdown. Use to improve accessibility by providing descriptive text for screen readers, especially when the picker is embedded in contexts where the default label may not be clear.

onCompanyChange.description: Callback function to be called when the company changes
